verdict.rationale: incident.io ships AI features (postmortem drafting, suggestions, Scribe, Investigations), so whether customer data is used for model training is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions a no-training commitment, a training opt-out, or a data-usage policy for AI. The investigations trust-and-safety pages cover agent boundaries and transparency, not training-data use, so they earn no credit here.
